summary: JATT II Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Talawar Tx Inc. and its merger sub. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into JATT, with JATT surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Talawar Tx, effectively taking the operating company public. The boards of both JATT and Talawar Tx approved the transaction. No exact terms such as price per share, premium, or valuation were disclosed in this excerpt. The combined entity will continue operations through Talawar Tx. This is a de-SPAC merger, which typically requires shareholder approval and regulatory review. The risk-arb angle centers on JATT stockholders' vote and potential redemptions, which could affect the available trust proceeds.
